children.value: > Fact From Story: After years of slow progress on misinformation — and worrisome backsliding on platforms like Elon Musk’s X — the Supreme Court’s decision could upend that process, sowing chaos online in the process.
> > Fact From Story: In both instances, a provision of the state law instructed social media companies to stop removing certain kinds of content.

> > Fact From Story: the Supreme Court is poised to decide whether a pair of state laws are allowed to reshape the ability of social media companies to control what does — and doesn’t — appear on their platforms.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Laws can influence what happens.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The Supreme Court makes decisions.
